name: cloudbase
description: Tencent CloudBase CLI wrappers for official kimi-cli plugins (Beta, docs 2026-08-18). Prefer kimi.plugin.json + mcpServers on Kimi Code 0.34.0.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query CloudBase databases. postgresql/mysql run SQL via `tcb db execute`. nosql lists data models via `tcb db model list` (full document CRUD is on the MCP server in kimi.plugin.json). Requires `tcb login`.

engine.description: Database engine. postgresql and mysql execute SQL; nosql lists CloudBase data models.

sql.description: SQL statement. Required for postgresql and mysql. Ignored for nosql.

envId.description: CloudBase environment ID. Optional; falls back to current tcb env.

readOnly.description: MySQL only: run in read-only mode. Ignored for PostgreSQL.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List CloudBase cloud functions via `tcb fn list --json`. Requires `tcb login`.

envId.description: CloudBase environment ID. Optional; falls back to current tcb env.

tools.name: list_storage
tools.description: List CloudBase cloud storage objects via `tcb storage list --json`. Requires `tcb login`.

envId.description: CloudBase environment ID. Optional; falls back to current tcb env.

cloudPath.description: Cloud storage prefix. Omit to list from the bucket root.

tools.name: list_cloudrun
tools.description: List CloudBase Run services via `tcb cloudrun list --json`. Requires `tcb login`.

envId.description: CloudBase environment ID. Optional; falls back to current tcb env.
